subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: Should Android chat messages get only Copy/Select Copy now, or the full long-press action menu with Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply?
rationale: Current main and the latest release lack the requested behavior, but the full proposed menu adds user-facing interaction semantics beyond a narrow text-selection repair, and same-repository implementation attempts have closed unmerged.

options.title: Approve Copy/Select Copy first
options.body: Land a smaller Android chat interaction focused on copying and text selection, preserving link tapping and LazyColumn scrolling before considering Share and Reply.

options.title: Approve full action menu
options.body: Treat Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply as one product feature and require end-to-end Android proof for all actions.

options.title: Decline native message actions
options.body: Keep code-block-only selection and close the request as out of current Android scope.

recommendation.title: Approve Copy/Select Copy first
recommendation.body: Land a smaller Android chat interaction focused on copying and text selection, preserving link tapping and LazyColumn scrolling before considering Share and Reply.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is both assigned on the issue and the strongest recent owner signal for Android chat UI/markdown history.
